name: QR Code Generator
tagline: Free HTTP API that generates downloadable QR code images from text or URLs
description: Simple free public HTTP API from goQR.me that turns submitted text or URLs into QR code images. The create-qr-code endpoint supports PNG, GIF, JPEG/JPG, SVG, and EPS output without signup, making it useful for embeds, email signatures, and print assets.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public HTTP GET endpoints; no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free unlimited use for reasonable traffic; commercial use allowed. No published hard free quota. Very high volume may require contacting them.

rate_limits: No request limit. The provider may reject requests it considers abusive or inappropriate. Services regularly generating more than 10,000 requests per day should notify the provider.

example.response_snippet: Binary PNG image bytes (Content-Type: image/png). For SVG: ...&format=svg returns XML SVG markup.

use_cases: generate a PNG QR code image from a URL or plain text
create SVG QR codes for print or high-resolution embeds
build a simple endpoint that returns QR codes without a local library
embed QR codes in emails, invoices, or tickets from a server script
